feedback:
Approved because only one action run remains. A revise round would need a review and a revision before the race, so approving is the only way this iteration gets a scored race.

The candidate changes two things from the iteration 4 best (score 555.0). First, geometry.sensor_positions returns to the iteration 4 spread (x = -0.024, -0.012, 0, 0.012, 0.024 m). Iteration 5 showed the wider spread lowered the score to 513.3, with s-bend finishes falling from 9 of 20 to 2 of 20, steering_oscillation rising from 0.36 to 0.51, and the slalom still at 0 of 20 with max_error 0.063. Second, controller.kd goes from 0.8 to 0.9. Iteration 3 to 4 showed that kp 3.0 with kd 0.8 cut s-bend max_error to 0.053, but the s-bend still had steering_oscillation of 0.36 and the slalom still had max_error of 0.061 with one line-loss event per run. The kd change is a single-parameter step from the best evidence, so it is a low-risk test of damping. base_speed 1.1, kp 3.0, ki 0, sensor_weights and line_loss 'last_direction' are unchanged.

The next race will show whether kd 0.9 helps. The next iteration's Optimizer should read the telemetry as follows. If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.4, or s-bend completions drop below the iteration 4 level of 9 of 20, revert kd to 0.8, since that is past the useful range at kp 3.0. If the slalom max_error falls below 0.06 and line_loss_events drop toward 0.5, keep kd 0.9 and consider a further small step. If the slalom still ends off track with kd 0.9 and steering_oscillation has not fallen, the remaining lever is kp, so test kp 2.8 with kd 0.9 rather than changing speed or geometry again.
requested_changes: If s-bend steering_oscillation rises above about 0.4 or s-bend completions fall below the iteration 4 level of 9 of 20 with kd 0.9, revert controller.kd to 0.8, since iteration 4 showed steering_oscillation of 0.36 at kd 0.8 and kd damping is near its useful limit at kp 3.0.

If the slalom still ends off track with max_error at or above 0.06 at kd 0.9, test controller.kp of about 2.8 with kd 0.9 and the iteration 4 sensor spread, because iteration 5 showed the wider spread did not clear the slalom and speed reduction to 1.1 did not either.

Keep geometry.sensor_positions at the iteration 4 spread (x = -0.024, -0.012, 0, 0.012, 0.024 m) and base_speed at 1.1, since iteration 5 cut the score from 555.0 to 513.3 with the wider spread and the oval, s-bend and steering-oscillation results all worsened.
